method: No model/API/target code execution; the tokenizer asset was pre-cached and network access was disabled for this run. All selectors run before gold is read. A0 is actual build_review_context output; A1 is strict rendered-patch prefix fit; B is cross-file hunk round-robin; C is global existing rule/AST risk plus declaration tie-break; D_prefix is an actual-builder parser-order injection restored in finally, then strict-fit.

input_manifest.split_definition: datasets/dev/split.json; 9 dev, 15 previously used holdout regressions, 1 excluded; all input cases must map to exactly one split member
input_manifest.rule_scanner: scan_signals(include_cross_file=False, include_linters=False); warnings retained as counts
input_manifest.rule_line_match: same normalized file and inclusive gold [start_line,end_line]; position-only proxy, never semantic TP

secondary_strategy_factors.B: round-robin by original diff file order and hunk order; complete hunks only; skip non-fitting hunk and continue
secondary_strategy_factors.C: global complete-hunk sort key (-flagged, -triage_score, -declaration_signature_regex, path, new_start); triage_score=10*rule_hits + 10*risky + 0.02*churn + 0.5*public_interface; flagged when rule_hits>0 or score>=10; uses production scan_signals; removes per-file cap
secondary_strategy_factors.D_full: custom complete-hunk greedy selector; production file order and per-file cap; first source hunk, then descending cl100k raw-hunk token count with stable original-index ties; fit uses complete hunks and per-file/final rendered budgets
secondary_strategy_factors.D_prefix: controlled actual-builder probe; temporarily reorder parse_file_hunks to first source hunk then descending cl100k raw-hunk token count, stable original-index ties; restore parser in finally; run actual build_review_context; then strict rendered-patch prefix fit to 6000 tokens

selection_detail.d_hunk_priority: first source hunk; then descending cl100k hunk tokens, stable original index
